Hire an interim manager or specialist

Email us an outline of the job. Say why you need someone now and what they’ll be responsible for when they arrive.

What to put in the brief

  • The work you need done, and what you expect to have in hand at the end.
  • Who the person will report to, which decisions they can make, and which need approval.
  • The start date, likely duration, location, and budget, as far as you know them.

We’ll go through the brief with you, discuss the experience needed, and agree how you’ll select and contract with the person.

Email an assignment brief

Example brief

‘Our head of service is leaving in March. We need someone for four months to manage the team and prepare the handover. They’ll report to the director, who will keep responsibility for the budget.’

If you want a consultancy team to take responsibility for a piece of work, see RedQuadrant’s services.
